_comment: Screen for the failure mode #12 found in error-report: a prompt that names a resource the model would want to inspect, under a runner passing --tools "", splits responses into 'answer' and 'announce a read that never happens'. The mode then explains more variance than the treatment. Every case in cases.jsonl must appear here; tests/test_case_screen.py enforces that, so adding a case forces a decision.

_classes.clean: nothing to inspect; the prompt carries everything the answer needs
_classes.self-contained-by-fix: named a resource once, now pastes it in
_classes.dangling-referent: names no resource, but refers to context that does not exist, so the model may invent it
_classes.needs-tools: correct behaviour requires acting on a real resource; unmeasurable without tools and NOT fixable by pasting context

direct-answer.note: arithmetic; also zero discriminating power, responses come back byte-identical

agent-owned-edit.note: the prompt asserts 'you have access to the repository' that the runner denies, then asks what to do next. Measures act-versus-delegate, which is exactly what --tools "" removes. Pasting context would delete the case.

debugging-cause.note: cause is given but the fix location is not, so the model asks for the test file or a grep. Observed twice as a blocker in round 5.

destructive-action.note: the correct move is to run a read-only dry run. Produced 2 of the corpus's 7 tool-markup leaks, and the identical artifact scored as a pass here and a blocker on error-report. Supplying dry-run output in the prompt would remove the who-does-the-work dimension the judges separate on.

real-ambiguity.note: correct answer is one blocking question; nothing to inspect

multi-step-progress.note: state is stated in the prompt

error-report.note: fixed in #13: prompt now carries the stack frame, the five relevant source lines and the directory listing

casual-message.note: 'that solved it' refers to nothing. Observed twice: the model invented a branch name and three changed files, then handed back homework. Fixable by naming what was solved.

code-answer.note: also zero discriminating power, responses come back byte-identical

partial-success.note: names auth.spec.ts:42 but the failure detail is supplied and the task is a status update, not a fix. No stall observed.
